description: The file-organizer skill encourages renaming as a normal part of organizing (including prescribing naming conventions), but it does not clearly default to preserving filenames unless the user explicitly requests renaming. This is risky for tasks with hard constraints like “Do not change files' name / files' content.”

description: The file-organizer skill claims it can organize files by “understanding context,” but its procedure does not include any concrete, content-based extraction workflow for PDFs/DOCX/PPTX (e.g., extracting text to classify by subject). It mainly suggests grouping by type/purpose/date and simple shell inspection, which is insufficient for a content-driven classification task like organizing papers by subject.

The file-organizer skill’s suggested outputs and workflow allow extra folders like “ToSort”/“Archive” and does not enforce a fixed, pre-specified set of destination folders with an “exactly one folder per file, no leftovers” guarantee. This conflicts with tasks that require distributing every file into exactly one of a fixed set of subject folders (no additional buckets).
